title: Safety and Efficacy Study of TwHF in HIV Patients With Poor Immune Responses
brief_summary: This study is a pilot study to evaluate impact of Tripterygium Wilfordii Hook F (TwHF) on T cell immune activation and immune activation in HIV-infected immunological non-responders. The investigators aim to evaluate the safety and efficacy profiles of TwHF in HIV immunological non-responders.
